Renovation & renewal

A new chapter for your space.

Understand what deserves to stay and what needs to work differently.

01

Keep what matters.

Identify the qualities you value: a generous window, a familiar room, or a material with character. These can become the starting point for a space that feels renewed without losing its identity.

02

Look beyond the finish.

Consider movement, storage, light, and the relationship between rooms before choosing surface treatments. The most useful changes often begin with how a space works rather than how it looks.

03

Define the scope.

List the rooms involved and how the work may affect daily use. Share available information about the building so the team can discuss what needs to be assessed before developing a design.
